annotations.title: Read how a role's job is changing

description: One ROLE page's story: hands-on hours a month by kind of work (rote, judgment, relationship, sign-off) before its first change or Task landed and now; what landed and when; new work it took on (checks inside Tasks, Tasks it looks after, work a change added), with whether each has settled; the role's size (people × hours each, `hoursAssumed` when the hours are a full-time default) and how much of its month is documented; and the latest analysis, when someone ran one: options for where saved hours could go, each with the stage of its change (proposed = looking into, agreed, done = in place, confirmed, dropped), and skills. Saved hours in a role with under half its month documented are unproven: say so. Talk about the role, never about a person.
